obfuscation_indicators: out of compliance with a debt covenant
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally detailed and quantified, but relies on standard accounting-policy caveats and forecast-based assumptions. Risk is elevated by the 85.4% increase in net loss, materially higher revolver borrowings and interest expense, and a debt-covenant violation that required a waiver through December 31, 2024. Management remains cautiously reassuring about liquidity, asserting that operating cash flow and available financing will cover foreseeable needs.
